hints.title: Sort by Efficiency Descending
hints.text: Sort engineers by efficiency in descending order. When an engineer is chosen, their efficiency acts as the team minimum.

hints.title: Track Top k Speeds
hints.text: Maintain the largest speeds among engineers considered so far using a min-priority structure of capacity at most k.

hints.title: Compute and Maximize Performance
hints.text: Multiply current speed sum by current efficiency to get performance. Update maximum across all steps, returning modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial combinations of size up to k is exponential in N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by efficiency fixes minimum factor, allowing a min-heap to maintain the best k speeds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate fixes the efficiency bottleneck by descending sort, tracking speed sum with a min-heap.
complexity.notes: Final answer is modulo 10^9 + 7, but internal performance is tracked with full 64-bit precision.
